title: Private Baseball Lessons in Lakewood, CA | MBM Baseball Training
description: 1-on-1 youth baseball lessons in Lakewood — hitting, fielding, throwing, pitching, and the mental game with Coach Myles, minutes from home base. Free first lesson.
lead: Lakewood sits about 15 minutes from our Long Beach home base, which makes it one of the easiest places for Coach Myles to meet your player for a true 1-on-1 lesson.
body: Lakewood is a baseball town. Between Lakewood Little League and the city's own Lakewood Youth Sports program, there's no shortage of kids playing ball here — which means your player is competing against a deep field every season. Private lessons are how a lot of them find another gear.

We coach the whole game — hitting, fielding, throwing, pitching, and baseball IQ — but we lead with development and mindset. The aim is steady, healthy progress that holds up under game pressure, not a quick fix that fades by the next weekend.

Coach Myles travels to you. We'll pick a field nearby and build the session around exactly what your player is working on, whether that's tryout prep, a swing fix, or first-pitch confidence on the mound.

fields.name: Rynerson Park

fields.name: Mayfair Park
fields.note: Lakewood's flagship rec park and home of the city's Lakewood Youth Sports baseball.

fields.name: Palms Park
fields.note: East Lakewood park with ball diamonds and a community center.

scene: Lakewood is served by Lakewood Little League (playing out of Rynerson Park) and the city-run Lakewood Youth Sports program, which fields baseball, softball, and t-ball for ages 4–17.
travel: About a 15-minute drive from our Long Beach home base.

faq.a: Yes — Lakewood is one of our closest service areas, about 15 minutes from home base. We meet your player at a local field.

faq.q: Can you help with Little League or LYS tryouts?
faq.a: Absolutely. A lot of our Lakewood work is tryout and in-season prep — we build the plan around what the coaches are looking for.
Sessions run 30 or 60 minutes. The free first lesson is a 30-minute evaluation with Coach Myles.
